text:
mina: Heads-up: canary slice canary-9 shows increased p999 on /v1/streaming since deploy at 2026-03-24T11:05Z. p95 minor, but tails bad.

deploybot: Alert: canary-9 p999 spike detected. Autorevert policy set to p95 only; will NOT trigger for p999.

josh: If p95 is fine but p999 is high, we should avoid full autorevert. Can we toggle the streaming-optim flag off for the slice?

rachel: Yes. Command: `deployctl set-flag --service gateway --flag streaming-optim --value false --slice canary-9`

oncall-bot: Incident created incident/2026-03-24-canary-stream-tail. Pagerduty: oncall (leo) alerted.

mina: Approving targeted flag rollback. Release lead (rachel) please confirm to block autorevert.

rachel: Blocking autorevert for 15m. Do the flag change, josh.

josh: Applied override at 2026-03-24T11:07:10Z with TTL 30m. Observability: p999 down to baseline within 40s.

mina: Good. Next: 1) patch config-uploader so override persists until fix, 2) file INFRA-7510 to include p999 in autorevert signals or add separate tail-latency trigger, 3) update release notes to say we rolled back streaming optimization for long-tail stability.

leo: Monitoring healthy. If stable for 20m we'll unpin and schedule proper fix.
